name: Expandi
summary: LinkedIn and email outreach automation for sales teams and agencies, with smart limits, warm-up and multi-account management.
best_for: sales teams and agencies running LinkedIn (and email) outreach at scale who want smart sending limits, warm-up and multi-account management
skip_if: you send occasional connection requests (LinkedIn's native tools suffice), or you're uneasy about automation against LinkedIn's terms of service
honest_knock: There is no free tier and no cheap entry: Expandi starts at $99 a month per seat, and the friendlier $79 assumes annual commitment. It's also LinkedIn automation, which sits in a grey zone against LinkedIn's own terms: powerful for outreach, but a platform-risk you own.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Solo (1 LinkedIn account) · per month, month-to-month per account
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07; re-read 2026-11-23, when the page had moved to published volume tiers) 7-day free trial, no free plan; the FAQ says you are charged only once you decide to use Expandi after the trial. Pricing is per LinkedIn account, one seat each, on two tabs. For teams: Solo, 1 account, $99 a month month-to-month or $79 a month billed annually; Studio, 2 to 10 accounts, $89 or $69 per account a month; above 10 accounts the team tab sends you to sales. For agencies: Launch, 11 to 24 accounts, $79 or $59 per account a month; Growth, 25 to 50 accounts, $69 or $49; Agency+, 50+ accounts, quote only. The billing toggle says "Save 20%", which holds exactly only on Solo: $948 a year against $1,188, a $240 saving that the FAQ also calls two months free, closer to two and a half. Checked tier by tier, the annual discount is 22% on Studio, 25% on Launch and 29% on Growth. The page lists the same features in every seat; image and GIF personalisation and video personalisation through Sendspark are paid add-ons. Taxes vary by country and are added on top.
